recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a woman sitting on a white decorative breeze block wall in a desert environment, featuring tall cacti in the background and a warm, sun-drenched color palette with a vintage film grain texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject sitting on a low horizontal wall bisecting the lower third
Vertical cacti echoing the verticality of the condensed typography
Warm skin tones and peach-colored text harmonizing with the desert sand
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows on the subject's black top
coreInvariants: Presence of tall, green cacti in the mid-ground
White geometric breeze block wall as a seating element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered vertically, slightly right of center horizontally, occupying the middle and lower thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white breeze block wall provides a strong horizontal foundation.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large text on the left, move to the subject's face, follow her posture down to the boots, and across the secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky/background area in the top right provides breathing room for the subject's head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and sand tones in the background and skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black of the subject's shirt and dark shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted peach/cream for the typography and white for the breeze blocks.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in highlights with desaturated, earthy mid-tones and crushed blacks.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'K' and 'A' have very acute angles due to the condensation
The 'S' has a vertical, compressed spine

composition.position: center right, adjacent to primary text
composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the negative space of the subject's waist

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scales of the same condensed sans-serif family to create hierarchy through size and weight.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment with the subject's waistline

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, industrial feel of the primary text.
Provides the clean, vertical structure required for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A woman with long brown hair wearing a black t-shirt and patterned shorts sitting on a white decorative breeze block wall. Background features tall green cacti and a desert landscape under warm, hazy sunlight. Apply a vintage film grain and a warm color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, extra-condensed bold sans-serif text in a peach-cream color on the left side, stacked vertically. Add a smaller line of condensed sans-serif text in cream to the right of the main text, aligned with the bottom edge of the second word.

verificationChecks: Is the text extra-condensed and uppercase?
Does the color palette feel warm and sun-bleached?
Is the subject sitting on a white geometric wall?
Are there tall cacti in the background?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of peach for the text
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the breeze block wall looks weathered and white.
Verify the film grain is consistent across the entire image.
Confirm the typography color is a muted cream/peach, not pure white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desert-themed portrait with heavy, vertically-oriented condensed typography to create a modern-vintage country aesthetic.
